name: nekoweb-mcp-server
description: Manage your Nekoweb website: browse, edit, upload and deploy files, and check site stats.
long_description: Lets Claude browse, read, edit, upload, move and delete the files on your Nekoweb site, deploy a zip of a built site, and check your views, followers and API rate limits.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Generate one at https://nekoweb.org/api. It gives full access to your site's files.

local_root.title: Upload folder (optional)
local_root.description: Only let the upload tools read files inside this folder. Leave empty to allow any file you name.

tools.name: nekoweb_get_site_info
tools.description: Show a site's title, views, followers and dates

tools.name: nekoweb_list_sites
tools.description: List the sites on your account and their folders

tools.name: nekoweb_read_file
tools.description: Read a file's source or view an image

tools.name: nekoweb_write_file
tools.description: Create or replace a text file

tools.name: nekoweb_create
tools.description: Create an empty file or folder

tools.name: nekoweb_move
tools.description: Rename or move a file or folder

tools.name: nekoweb_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a file or folder
